prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for adoption (new_flow, new_screen), choose_path (layout, notification, redesign), finish (hint, new_flow), and sign_in layout due to having only single tests.
Home new_flow and choose_path copy are the only helpful kinds of change, each producing one winning test, though other tests of these kinds showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen (3 tests), sign_in hint (3 tests), finish copy (2 tests), sign_in copy (2 tests), and home redesign (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign (2 tests) produced no winning tests, showing no clear effect or negative impact.
Predictions were overall overly optimistic across most tests, though predictions for copy changes were occasionally too low (such as the winning Round 7 choose_path copy test).

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] waiting_room_pet_sound_teaser_flow: Adds an interactive audio teaser component to the waiting screen allowing users to preview pet vocalizations while waiting for generation to finish. (why: Home conversion is delayed by a long generation wait (mean 2336s). Providing interactive audio keeps users engaged and reduces abandonment.)
1: [choose_path, copy] story_screen_quick_companion_reassurance_copy: Updates the headline and body text on the story screen to reassure users that pet setup takes under a minute. (why: Choose path drop-off has a high mean completion time of 514s versus an 8s median, suggesting user hesitancy that fast-setup copy helps solve.)
2: [finish, new_screen] new_desktop_pet_summon_guide_screen: Inserts a dedicated guidance screen right before home intro showing shortcuts to summon, hide, or talk to the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple emails about pets not appearing on desktop and users being confused about how to control or hide pets after onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_pet_restore_notice: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account resets. (why: The single largest support theme (8 emails) is users reporting missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
4: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_quick_customization_hint: Displays a tip below path selection confirming that choice decisions are non-binding and customizable later. (why: Choose_path copy tweaks have proven effective in past iterations, and addressing user hesitation targets the 514s mean time.)
5: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_background_generation_notice: Adds explicit waiting status copy reassuring users that pet creation proceeds smoothly in the background. (why: The waiting step accounts for significant drop-off and high mean duration (2336s). Clear status reduces premature app closure.)
6: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_multi_angle_tip_hint: Provides guidance on photo upload screen on how to submit clear photos for accurate pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted visual results.)
7: [sign_in, incentive] sign_in_cloud_pet_backup_assurance: Adds a cloud backup assurance badge on the sign-in screen highlighting automatic pet data sync. (why: Directly targets the top support issue (8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after account sign-in).)
